author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Google's Gemini Omni step by step.

In this tutorial, you'll learn how to create AI-generated videos using Google's latest video generation model. I'll show you how to generate videos from text prompts, edit existing videos with simple instructions, apply visual styles using reference images, create AI avatars, add dialogue and audio, manage your projects, and use Google Flow for larger video productions.

Whether you're new to AI video generation or looking to get more out of Google's latest tools, this guide will walk you through everything you need to know.

In this video:
• Create videos from text prompts
• Edit videos with natural language instructions
• Apply styles using reference images
• Create and use AI avatars
• Generate dialogue and audio
• Organize projects in the library
• Explore Google Flow for advanced workflows

Host: Kevin Stratvert

- Google Gemini: https://gemini.google.com
- Google Flow: http://flow.google
